Gita Jayanti (गीता जयंती)

A Day of Reflection and Devotion: Celebrating Gita Jayanti at Home

Gita Jayanti marks the auspicious day Lord Krishna imparted the sacred Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna. It's a time for spiritual introspection, devotion, and gratitude for this divine wisdom.

  1. Early Morning

    Setting Intentions and Beginning the Vrata

    Awaken with a peaceful mind, offer a silent prayer, and begin your vrata (fast) as a mark of devotion and spiritual discipline for the day.

  2. Morning

    Engaging with the Bhagavad Gita

    Dedicate time to reading chapters from the Bhagavad Gita, listening to online discourses, or participating in virtual kirtans to deepen your understanding of its timeless teachings.

  3. Late Afternoon

    Preparing for Evening Prayers and Feasting

    As the day progresses, gather your diyas (lamps) and begin preparing the satvik dishes for breaking your fast, ensuring everything is ready for the evening's devotion.

    Recipes: Sattvic Moong Dal Khichdi · Jaggery Sesame Ladoo (Gur Til Ladoo) · Fresh Sugarcane Juice (Ganne ka Ras) · Cardamom Milk (Elaichi Doodh)

  4. Sundown

    Lighting Diyas and Evening Prayers

    As dusk falls, light your diyas at your home altar, symbolizing the light of knowledge. Offer heartfelt prayers, reflecting on the wisdom of the Gita and Lord Krishna's divine guidance.

  5. After Evening Prayers

    Breaking the Vrata Fast with Satvik Delights

    Conclude your day of devotion by breaking your fast with a nourishing satvik meal, sharing the blessed food with gratitude for the Lord's teachings and the wisdom of the Gita.

    Recipes: Sattvic Moong Dal Khichdi · Jaggery Sesame Ladoo (Gur Til Ladoo) · Fresh Sugarcane Juice (Ganne ka Ras) · Cardamom Milk (Elaichi Doodh)

May the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita illuminate your path and bring peace to your heart this Gita Jayanti.

Feast-day recipes

  • Sattvic Moong Dal Khichdi
  • Jaggery Sesame Ladoo (Gur Til Ladoo)
  • Fresh Sugarcane Juice (Ganne ka Ras)
  • Cardamom Milk (Elaichi Doodh)
